entry.title: MonoSlide 1.0.3
entry.summary: Reduces redundant filter calculations: measured idle CPU fell from 8.7% to 7.5% of one core, about 14% less. Audio output matches the previous engine exactly across 27 regression cases; controls and project compatibility are unchanged. Tested on MPC Live 2 Retro / AKAI MPC OS 3.9.1. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/Eurikon/mpc-vst-plugins/tree/main/Instruments/Monoslide#installation).
